prototype_sources.Dockerfile:
FROM ubuntu:26.04@sha256:f144425ff09be612d6d9ad965196e9cdc23dae1f42110a8a11a3e9a8198759f7
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
COPY apt-packages.txt /experiment/apt-packages.txt
RUN apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates curl sudo zstd && grep -v '^#' /experiment/apt-packages.txt | xargs apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends
prototype_sources.install.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
: > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/docker-clean
phase_start=$SECONDS
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates curl sudo zstd > /tmp/bootstrap.log 2>&1 || { tail -30 /tmp/bootstrap.log; exit 1; }
printf 'env-bench phase=bootstrap seconds=%d\n' "$((SECONDS - phase_start))"
phase_start=$SECONDS
grep -v '^#' /experiment/apt-packages.txt | xargs apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends > /tmp/packages.log 2>&1 || { tail -30 /tmp/packages.log; exit 1; }
printf 'env-bench phase=packages seconds=%d\n' "$((SECONDS - phase_start))"
printf 'env-bench package-fingerprint='
dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\t${Version}\n' | sort | sha256sum

excluded_trials: warm1 had a separate bosn machine volume, so it was not archive-warm; it also overlapped image work.
warm2 used shared seeded archives but overlapped image export and package work.
First prepared task was refused during Docker context revalidation; excluding archive/log paths fixed it, and no failed attempt counts as a timing success.
limitations: Local container/IO performance differs substantially from GitHub; no CI speedup is established.
Both compared images were locally resident; no registry publication or fresh-runner pull/unpack measurement.
Resolved package/version fingerprints match; the prototype recipe does not pin mutable apt repository contents for future rebuilds.
Only one quiet comparison; other benchmark jobs had finished, but this is not a controlled whole-host-idle benchmark.
decision: Retain current stock image and apt caching; defer deployment until approved immutable publication and fresh-runner net benefit are verified.
